meaning:
ἀκαίρως, adv.
(ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), [in LXX: Si 35 (32):4 * ;]
out of season, unseasonably: opposite to εὐκαίρως (which see), 2Ti.4:2 (cf. Cremer, 740; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.
